title: Report a live process id
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*).

Find a process that is alive: the pid of systemd if present, otherwise pid 1. device_processes is fine if you then confirm the pid exists under /proc. Record evidence metric `live_pid` whose observed value is that pid and nothing else.

Do not kill processes. Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration.
acceptance: pid=$(ps -eo pid,comm | awk '$2=="systemd"{print $1; exit}'); if [ -z "${pid:-}" ]; then pid=1; fi; test -d "/proc/$pid"

evidence.probe: pid=$(ps -eo pid,comm | awk '$2=="systemd"{print $1; exit}'); if [ -z "${pid:-}" ]; then pid=1; fi; printf '%s\n' "$pid"
